thread:
tess: hey team, day 1! trying to finish the onboarding checklist but running into a perms blocker. need Console Env Panel access — qa admin to run flag smoke tests, prod readonly to read runbooks. who can help fast?
jen: welcome tess :wave: fastest path is an infra-permissions ticket with manager approval. include which flags and how long you need access. infra often grants QA admin same day; prod readonly may require SCIM group sync.
tess: can someone drop a minimal ticket body i can copy into the queue?
jen: use this minimal template:
```
Title: Console Env Panel access - tess
Requester: tess
Manager: mike (manager)
Environments: qa (admin), prod (readonly)
Flags: onboarding.*
Duration: 7 days
Reason: onboarding tests + runbook verification
```
infra: small note: if you plan to flip flags during a live rollout, list rollout ids and the time window. otherwise admin toggles will be QA-only by default. also infra will ask for manager signoff in the ticket body to speed approval.
tess: filed ticket INF-6007 and pasted the manager approval line. tagged @jen and @mike.
access-bot: verification tips once infra confirms: check Console -> top-right avatar -> "My permissions" OR run:
```bash
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://console.internal/api/v1/me/roles | jq
```
access-bot: look for `\"env_panel\": \"admin\"` under qa and `\"env_panel\": \"readonly\"` under prod. if values don't match, reply here and tag @infra.
mike: approved in the ticket :+1: i'm on the ticket thread too; infra please expedite, tess is shadowing a demo this afternoon.
infra: QA admin granted. prod readonly pending SCIM sync (queued). estimate <1 hour. we'll post here when sync completes.
tess: perfect, thanks! i'll avoid flipping flags until i get explicit confirmation.
jen: congrats and welcome aboard :tada: when prod readonly lands i'll paste the safe-flip checklist with audit steps.
